note.question: How does consumer-generated quality information (e.g., consumer reviews) affect a firm’s dynamic pricing strategy in the presence of strategic consumers?
note.overview: In this paper, we study the impact of consumer-generated quality information (e.g., consumer reviews) on a firm’s dynamic pricing strategy in the presence of strategic consumers. Such information is useful, not only to the consumers that have not yet purchased the product but also to the firm. The informativeness of the consumer-generated quality information depends, however, on the volume of consumers who share their opinions and, thus, depends on the initial sales volume.
